acceptInvitation.title: Set your password
acceptInvitation.subtitle: The link you followed lets you set a password for your new account, once.
acceptInvitation.done: Your password has been set. Sign in with it to reach your account.
acceptInvitation.missingTokenBody: Open the link from your invitation e-mail again, or ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
acceptInvitation.refusedHint: If the link has expired or was already used, ask whoever invited you to send a new invitation.
